d: Benjamin Netanyahu faces intense political scrutiny as Arab voter turnout draws attention in Israel’s election battle. Could increased participation among Palestinian citizens of Israel reshape the electoral landscape and challenge Bibi’s political position? As votes are counted and results emerge, all eyes are on turnout figures, party performances and the balance of power in the Israeli parliament.
